You could try to separate them so you can apply the right amount of water to each group.
I'll try that. I have a few pots on the windowsill and some on the porch—maybe I should move the succulents to a shadier spot too. Do you think that would help with the heat?

Moving the succulents to a shadier spot sounds like a very smart move! Direct, intense sun can definitely stress them out when you're away.

I'd recommend keeping the herbs and the succulents in slightly different areas. The succulents will love the shade, while the herbs might appreciate that extra sun. 

Keep me updated on how it goes! Let me know if you find any other challenges while I'm away.
I'll keep the herbs in the sun and move the succulents to the porch where it's cooler. I've got a few more pots on the windowsill that might need attention too—maybe I'll check them all after lunch.
